_doc: Gold Standard Corpus for ASM-ki-semantic-framing-sufficient verification. Each entry is a dialogue with expert annotations of the 7 SemanticFrame dimensions. Two independent annotators (rater_a, rater_b) rate each dialogue. See 1-spec/assumptions/ASM-ki-semantic-framing-sufficient.md for verification plan.

_dimensions.tone: Free text label (e.g., 'hesitant', 'confrontational', 'warm'). Normalized to lowercase for comparison.
_dimensions.themes: List of theme labels (e.g., ['self-doubt', 'decision-making']). Multi-label F1.
_dimensions.emotional_tenor: Float -1.0 to 1.0. Binned into 5 categories for F1: very_negative (<-0.6), negative (-0.6 to -0.2), neutral (-0.2 to 0.2), positive (0.2 to 0.6), very_positive (>0.6).
_dimensions.context_validity: Float 0.0 to 1.0. Binned into 3 categories: low (<0.4), medium (0.4 to 0.7), high (>0.7).
_dimensions.offline_context_risk: Float 0.0 to 1.0. Binned into 3 categories: low (<0.3), medium (0.3 to 0.6), high (>0.6).
